name: hero-liquid-metal
blurb: Hero with animated liquid-metal shader over icon, tech stack badges.
description: Responsive hero with heading, description, CTA, and tech badges. LiquidMetal shader animates over /cult-icon.svg with teal tint (RGB shift distortion). Desktop 1280×720, mobile responsive.
use_when: AI/SDK product with premium, fluid aesthetic; liquid effect creates organic, tech-forward impression.
avoid_when: Shader-intensive WebGL. Requires sized parent and /cult-icon.svg asset.
a11y: Screen-reader title (srTitle). Buttons and links focusable. Shader is decorative.
